API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISandbox Policy & SettingsBa Rule Resource Get Rules
Ba Rule Resource Get Rules
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/sandboxRules

Retrieves the list of all Sandbox policy rules configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn more, see About Sandbox.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier generated for the rule

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the Sandbox rule

protocols
string[]

The protocols to which the rule applies

Possible values: [ANY_RULE, SMRULEF_CASCADING_ALLOWED, FOHTTP_RULE, FTP_RULE, HTTPS_RULE, HTTP_RULE]

order
int32
REQUIRED

Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and this field specifies the order of execution for the rule.

baPolicyCategories
string[]

The threat categories to which the rule applies

Possible values: [ADWARE_BLOCK, BOTMAL_BLOCK, ANONYP2P_BLOCK, RANSOMWARE_BLOCK, OFFSEC_TOOLS_BLOCK, SUSPICIOUS_BLOCK]

description
string

The description of the rule

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
users
object[]
urlCategories
object[]
fileTypes
string[]
REQUIRED

The file types to which the rule applies

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, FTCATEGORY_FLASH, FTCATEGORY_JAVA_APPLET, FTCATEGORY_HTA, FTCATEGORY_ZIP, FTCATEGORY_TAR, FTCATEGORY_BZIP2, FTCATEGORY_RAR, FTCATEGORY_ISO, FTCATEGORY_P7Z, FTCATEGORY_SCZIP, FTCATEGORY_DMG, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_EXECUTABLES, FTCATEGORY_MICROSOFT_INSTALLER, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_LIBRARY, FTCATEGORY_PYTHON, FTCATEGORY_POWERSHELL, FTCATEGORY_VISUAL_BASIC_SCRIPT, FTCATEGORY_BAT, FTCATEGORY_JPEG, FTCATEGORY_PNG, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_SCRIPT_FILES, FTCATEGORY_APK, FTCATEGORY_MS_POWERPOINT, FTCATEGORY_MS_WORD, FTCATEGORY_MS_EXCEL, FTCATEGORY_MS_RTF, FTCATEGORY_PDF_DOCUMENT]

cbiProfile
object
cbiProfileId
int32

Unique identifier of the cloud browser isolation profiles to which the rule applies

state
string

The state of the rule indicating whether it is enabled or disabled

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
rank
int32

The admin rank specified for the rule based on your assigned admin rank. Admin rank determines the rule order that can be specified for the rule. Admin rank can be configured if it is enabled in the Advanced Settings. .

lastModifiedTime
int32

The timestamp when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
accessControl
string

The admin’s access privilege to this rule based on the assigned role

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

baRuleAction
string

The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK]

firstTimeEnable
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether a First-Time Action is specifically configured for the rule. The First-Time Action takes place when users download unknown files. The action to be applied is specified using the firstTimeOperation field.

firstTimeOperation
string

The action that must take place when users download unknown files for the first time

Possible values: [ALLOW_SCAN, QUARANTINE, ALLOW_NOSCAN, QUARANTINE_ISOLATE]

mlActionEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to enable or disable the AI Instant Verdict option to have the Zscaler service use AI analysis to instantly assign threat scores to unknown files. This option is available to use only with specific rule actions such as Quarantine and Allow and Scan for First-Time Action.

labels
object[]
devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
zpaAppSegments
object[]
byThreatScore
int32
defaultRule
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is marked as the default rule.

]
